directories.src/handlers: Contains 6 module files (answers.js, comments.js, checkpoints.js, marks.js)

Dockerfile.summary: This multi-stage `Dockerfile` builds and containerizes the Node.js application for production. It packages the compiled distribution and production dependencies, exposing port 8888 to run the service.

build.config.js.summary: This file configures and executes the project's bundling process using `esbuild`. It compiles `src/index.js` into a minified IIFE output at `dist/index.min.js`.

configs/values-dev.yaml.summary: This Helm values file defines development-specific deployment parameters, including `autoscaling`, environment variables, and `configmaps`. It configures the project's development environment infrastructure settings.

set-env-dev.sh.summary: This configuration script sets local development environment variables for the application, including database credentials and message broker settings. It prepares the local runtime environment.

configs/values-prod.yaml.summary: This file defines production configuration values for the `checkpoints` deployment, including autoscaling and environment variables. It serves as a Helm values override for the production environment.

package.json.summary: This `package.json` file configures project metadata, dependencies, and build scripts for the `checkpoints` project, serving as the central Node.js package configuration file.

src/handlers/answers.js.summary: This file handles the generation of checkpoint answers. It exports `createCheckpointAnswers` to assign unique variants for user progress and manage database persistence.

src/handlers/comments.js.summary: This file manages comment creation logic with role-based validation. It exports `saveComment` to handle comment persistence for students and mentors within the project.

src/handlers/checkpoints.js.summary: `src/handlers/checkpoints.js` manages challenge checkpoint retrieval and logic. It exports `getCheckpointContentForTeacher`, serving as a core request handler for fetching versioned checkpoint content.

src/handlers/marks.js.summary: This file handles mentor grading and submission workflows for student progress. It exports `saveQuestionMarks` and `setPublishedStatus` to manage checkpoint scores and publication states within the project.

src/handlers/evaluation.js.summary: This file handles the AI-powered evaluation of student checkpoint submissions and processes unanswered questions. It exports `handleUnansweredQuestions`, serving as the core evaluation handler in the project's backend routing/logic.

src/handlers/templates.js.summary: This file handles database operations for checkpoint templates using the `CheckpointTemplates` schema. It exports `getCheckpointTemplate` and `upsertCheckpointTemplate` to retrieve and manage challenge templates.
